notes:
Stability release — the app no longer closes when you tap an option.

• Fixed the crash that dropped you out to the phone's home screen when tapping options in Graphics or Scenes
• Fixed the same crash when saving or switching a destination, activating a licence, or logging out
• Fixed the login screen getting stuck on a loading spinner when the server couldn't be reached
• Go Live no longer closes the app if you tap it before the camera has finished starting
• Every button in the app and the studio is now guarded, so a failure shows a message instead of closing the app
• If something does go wrong, the app now tells you what happened on the next launch
